parse.title: Relics
parse.text:
Overview

Relics were introduced in Update 7 alongside the new damage types, and can heavily boost a unit's damage or usability if used correctly.

Buff Types

  • % DMG : Increases the damage of units of that type by a percentage.
  • PEN: Penetrates through resistances of enemies.
    • Resistance reduces damage by 100 / (100 + Resistance). So an enemy with 150 Magic Resistance will only take 40% Magic Damage.
  • PWR: Increases DPS/Upgrade. Scales with unit level. The amount will change if you equip it to a unit (to reflect the unit level scaling).

Relics

  • Obtainable
  • Tears
  • Unobtainable

Trivia

  • You can't equip relics on Epic or below.
  • You can only equip one of each Unique Relic to a team at a time. (Ex: You can't have two units with Mirrorblade on the same team.)
  • Relics can be unequipped, allowing you to move them from unit to unit, as needed.
  • There are currently no Rare or Secret relics.
